description: Source code for the oa_tc6 Ethernet driver, including register read/write, status checks, and data chunk handling.

methods.name: oa_tc6_reg_read
methods.description: Reads a register from the oa_tc6 device via SPI.

methods.name: oa_tc6_reg_write
methods.description: Writes a value to a register on the oa_tc6 device via SPI.

methods.name: oa_tc6_reg_rmw
methods.description: Performs read-modify-write operation on a device register.

methods.name: oa_tc6_set_protected_ctrl
methods.description: Enables or disables protected mode on the device.

methods.name: oa_tc6_send_chunks
methods.description: Sends data in chunks over SPI to the device.

methods.name: oa_tc6_check_status
methods.description: Checks the status of the device and clears pending interrupts.

methods.name: oa_tc6_read_status
methods.description: Reads the status footer from the device.

methods.name: oa_tc6_read_chunks
methods.description: Reads data chunks from the device and assembles into a packet.

methods.name: oa_tc6_chunk_spi_transfer
methods.description: Performs SPI transfer for a data chunk with headers and footer.
